item.title: Doc on decline of kelp forests ‘Sequoias of the Sea’ to be screened at Santa Cruz Boardroom
item.description: Kelp forests are important to the environment in many ways: as a nursery ground for different marine life, a vital part of the marine food chain, barriers to coastline erosion and a major part of coastal economies. However, according to the National Science Foundation, more than 95% of kelp forests along the Northern California coast have vanished over the past decade, and its impacts have been widespread. item.title: Soquel’s boys basketball team silences Aptos, secures no worse than a share of SCCAL title | Local Roundup
item.description: Soquel High's boys basketball team shined again on defense, and the Knights beat host Aptos 52-23 on Saturday to secure no worse than a share of the Santa Cruz Coast Athletic League title.
